description: Decorative blank 5HP wide, drawn as the right-hand mounting bracket at the end of a Eurorack row, with two screw slots and no controls
menu: Ear Type — picks the artwork: Count Modula Logo, Minimalist, Release the Bats or Rockin' Bones
Default Ear Type — sets the artwork every rack ear added afterwards starts with, left-hand and right-hand ears sharing the one setting
Theme — recolours the panel: Set changes this module and Set default every Count Modula module added after it, choosing Silver, Absinthe, Blue Moon, Moonlight, Raven, Sanguine or Trick or Treat
